srs_deltas.text: A Content-Length list form (e.g. '2048, 2048', accepted by TinyHttpd 3.1.1) over the app rawBodyLimit on a mount WITHOUT .bodyLimit gets 413 only after the backend connect (the copy stops with BodyTooLargeException, backend connection closed), because the core parses only a single number as the declared length and the public API exposes no rawBodyLimit accessor; with .bodyLimit(n) the proxy refuses the list form before connecting. Fix belongs to the core declared-length 413 (FR-HTTP-031/D-014) reading the agreed list value.
